Dagny signs off on any field under 90%

Supplier invoices reach Hollinshead Joinery as attachments in the accounts inbox. The app reads INV-4471 from Ferrovale Timber into vendor, total, and due date. Any field read under 90% confidence waits for bookkeeper Dagny Lowenfeld, and the due date is one. Once she confirms it, the $2,840.00 bill is saved.
